domain-information: A Property Owner requests to list their home for sale so the agent can begin the process.
A Property Owner provides additional property details to complete the listing.
A Buyer asks for available homes within a certain price range to explore options.
A Buyer schedules a home viewing to see if the property fits their needs.
A Real Estate Agent prepares a new property listing to make it available to buyers.
A Real Estate Agent organizes a viewing appointment to show the property to interested buyers.
A Real Estate Agent submits a purchase offer on behalf of the buyer to start negotiations.
An Appraiser inspects the property to provide an estimated market value.
An Appraiser sends the valuation report to the agent for use in the negotiation.
An Appraiser reviews mandatory files submitted by the owner to confirm the accuracy of the valuation.

associations.description: Real Estate Agent prepares the Listing.
Buyer submits a Home Viewing Request.
Real Estate Agent reviews the Home Viewing Request.
Real Estate Agent schedules the Viewing Appointment.
Real Estate Agent creates the Purchase Offer.
Purchase Offer is sent to the Property Owner.
Valuation Report is delivered to the Real Estate Agent.
